The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties: the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02712 (EV-FARE-02712, cancellation_fee $4.50, total_charged $4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00) is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is paid. Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs. Limbs (a) and (d) are recorded: the trip record carries the driver's arrival event at 12:30:36 and a driver termination at 12:34:59 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW (one of the three codes limb (d) recognises). But limb (b) and limb (c) fail. This is a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-02712, pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, not 50 m, and the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02712) never places him inside it: his closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), the qualifying in-radius fix count is 0, and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s. Limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap, and against the 180 s free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02712, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) the shortfall is 180 s. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. The driver advocate's 263-second argument (claim 3, and the shortfall being 'a measurement of position, not of time allowed') is answered on its own terms and rejected as a ground for keeping the fee: the 263 s runs from 12:30:36 to 12:34:59, it is the time the driver allowed, and limb (c) does not measure from the button press. The driver's closest approach (258.2 m) sits outside the 120 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so POL-NS-03 independently refunds in full — he did not arrive at the pickup point. Both routes (POL-NS-02 for a trace with no in-radius fix at all, POL-NS-03 for a stationary position within 400 m) end in the same full refund, and the driver advocate properly concedes the fee is not chargeable. Why there is no driver payment. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 puts the loss on the driver for compensation purposes: the rider stated a specific sub-location in the chat log at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A', EV-CHAT-02712) and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of $2.25 (POL-NS-03(ii)) is unavailable because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, and because the rider did specify a sub-location. The driver's anti-farming position (claim 5) is correct as far as it goes — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 92, so neither limb of the POL-NS-07 check trips, and those are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test — but it changes nothing, because no compensation route is reached. The rider's POL-NS-04 point is not needed and does not carry her case: the driver replied 'ok' at 12:31:26, within 120 seconds of the rider's 12:30:56 message, so the clause does not exonerate her on driver non-response. Her presence is in fact affirmatively established (54 qualifying rider fixes, never more than 19.9 m from the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius), which contradicts the RIDER_NO_SHOW label, but the refund follows from the driver's own trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 regardless. Her point that the 12:30:36 event is a driver-pressed marker is accepted: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival. I do not record a false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii): that referral requires the GPS to place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp or moving at 15 km/h or more, and a closest approach of 258.2 m establishes neither, so no clause-mandated referral fires here. Confidence and effect. The facts the ruling rests on are carried by EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 and EV-CHAT-02712, all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the $4.50 fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so no POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) fires and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger holds; confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02712-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact relied on here. The monetary effect ($4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Two rider claims that relied on the weight-0.0 advisory without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment were discarded by the referee and are recorded in the audit below. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The driver never reached the pickup point. His own trace's closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m on EV-GPS-02712), more than twice the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 fixes for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, and the trace contains zero qualifying in-radius fixes at any point (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0). With no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before the 12:34:59 cancellation, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the cancellation fee is refundable in full.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept Even taking the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 12:30:36 at face value, POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap, and there is no such fix: the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period carried on this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a shortfall of 180 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The driver's 258.2 m minimum distance sits outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so failing the geofence test does not let the fee through: this is a wrong-approach case and the fee is refunded in full on either branch. If the driver was stationary there for the required dwell, POL-NS-03 governs and refunds in full; if he was not, POL-NS-02's own rule refunds in full because no qualifying in-radius fix exists. Fault is allocated to the driver under POL-NS-03 limb (i): the rider named her location in the chat at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712, EV-CHAT-02712 · clauses POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

kept Rider presence is affirmatively established for POL-NS-04 limb (c)'s rider-presence test: 54 rider fixes, all 54 qualifying, running 12:28:14 to 12:36:13, never more than 19.9 m from the pin and therefore far inside the 150 m rider presence radius for this LARGE_VENUE zone. I do not rely on POL-NS-04 as a whole for the refund, which comes from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06, but the presence fact this limb tests is exactly the fact the trip record's RIDER_NO_SHOW code denies.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-01

kept No driver compensation can attach. POL-NS-07 pays at 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces it, and POL-NS-03 limb (i) puts the loss on the driver because he was told the entrance and did not move. The $4.50 cancellation line on EV-FARE-02712 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is therefore refundable in full with a nil driver payout.

evidence EV-FARE-02712, EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-03

discarded The missing dwell cannot be topped up by summing separate in-geofence intervals: POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits that only where a traffic_advisory is present and populated and carries a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-02712-01 is MISSING, has a null payload and carries weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable, the zero dwell stands, and no exculpation can be built on that absent artifact.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02712-01, EV-GPS-02712 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02712-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

kept The 12:30:36 arrival is a driver-pressed marker, not a platform measurement: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is 'BUTTON', and POL-NS-12 covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals. POL-NS-12 therefore cannot convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival, and the marker remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05, where a trace whose minimum distance is 258.2 m with zero in-radius fixes means the tap starts no waiting clock at all.

evidence EV-TRIP-02712, EV-GPS-02712 · clauses POL-NS-12, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

discarded The record is clean enough to decide without escalation: EV-TRIP-02712, EV-GPS-02712, EV-CHAT-02712 and EV-FARE-02712 are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the trace has 100 percent coverage with no gaps and a 10 s cadence, the chat sequence and read receipts are intact, and the $4.50 cancellation line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) fire nowhere. No POL-NS-09 trigger holds either: no counter-party disputes are recorded on either profile, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the driver's single no_show_termination in 30 days against 92 completed trips is nowhere near the POL-NS-07 anti-farming threshold.

evidence EV-TRIP-02712, EV-GPS-02712, EV-CHAT-02712, EV-FARE-02712, EV-ADVIS-02712-01 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02

The driver advocate

kept POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the face of the trip record: it carries the driver's own arrival event at 12:30:36 ("I'm Here") and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:34:59 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. This was a recorded, correctly-labelled driver termination, not an unrecorded or mislabelled one, so the only live questions are limbs (b) and (c).

evidence EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The tests to be run are the LARGE_VENUE tests, not the STANDARD ones: trip_record.pickup_zone_class is LARGE_VENUE, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius for this pin is 120 m and POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance ceiling is 400 m, not the 50 m STANDARD radius. The driver's own trace puts his nearest fix at 258.2 m from the pickup pin - outside the arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling - so this is a wrong-face-of-the-same-pickup case to be decided under POL-NS-03, not a POL-NS-02 case of a driver who never came near the venue.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03

kept The driver did not cancel prematurely or harvest the fee off a token stop. 263 seconds ran from the arrival event at 12:30:36 to the termination at 12:34:59, and 261 seconds from the wait_timer_started event at 12:30:38, both longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force under POL-NS-01(c) (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The 180 second shortfall the derived arrival block reports is a measurement of in-geofence dwell - i.e. of the driver's position - not of the time he allowed the rider.

evidence EV-TRIP-02712, EV-GPS-02712 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06

kept The rider's coordination claim does not carry POL-NS-04. The rider's only locating message was sent at 12:30:56 and the driver answered 'ok' at 12:31:26, thirty seconds later and well inside the 120 seconds POL-NS-04(b) allows, so the clause does not exonerate the rider on driver non-response (it applies 'regardless of the content of the reply') and any residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03 on the chat log.

evidence EV-CHAT-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-03

kept Nothing in the driver's record withholds a payment to him if the Judge reaches a compensation route: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 that POL-NS-07's anti-farming limb requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 92 is 1.09 percent, far below the 8 percent limb. POL-NS-07 requires both limbs and neither is met, so the anti-farming condition does not trip and bars nothing here; these are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits to be used for this test.

evidence EV-DPROF-02712 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-01

kept I do not stretch the record on position. The derived arrival facts show 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0 seconds against 91 driver fixes, so the gps_trace never places the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius and POL-NS-01 limb (b) cannot be made out on this trace. The fee is not chargeable on this evidence and the driver does not assert otherwise.

evidence EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept Nor do I press for driver compensation, and I record why. The chat log shows the rider stated a specific sub-location at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') and the trace shows the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59, which is the limb (i) case of POL-NS-03, in which the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. And with trip_record.registered_pickup_points at 1, POL-NS-03(ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill (0.5 of the 4.50 fee, i.e. 2.25) is unavailable, because that limb requires 2 or more registered pickup points as well as the absence of any stated sub-location.

evidence EV-CHAT-02712, EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 · clauses POL-NS-03

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties: the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02712 (EV-FARE-02712, cancellation_fee $4.50, total_charged $4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00) is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is paid. Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs. Limbs (a) and (d) are recorded: the trip record carries the driver's arrival event at 12:30:36 and a driver termination at 12:34:59 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW (one of the three codes limb (d) recognises). But limb (b) and limb (c) fail. This is a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-02712, pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, not 50 m, and the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02712) never places him inside it: his closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), the qualifying in-radius fix count is 0, and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s. Limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap, and against the 180 s free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02712, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) the shortfall is 180 s. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. The driver advocate's 263-second argument (claim 3, and the shortfall being 'a measurement of position, not of time allowed') is answered on its own terms and rejected as a ground for keeping the fee: the 263 s runs from 12:30:36 to 12:34:59, it is the time the driver allowed, and limb (c) does not measure from the button press. The driver's closest approach (258.2 m) sits outside the 120 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so POL-NS-03 independently refunds in full — he did not arrive at the pickup point. Both routes (POL-NS-02 for a trace with no in-radius fix at all, POL-NS-03 for a stationary position within 400 m) end in the same full refund, and the driver advocate properly concedes the fee is not chargeable. Why there is no driver payment. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 puts the loss on the driver for compensation purposes: the rider stated a specific sub-location in the chat log at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A', EV-CHAT-02712) and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of $2.25 (POL-NS-03(ii)) is unavailable because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, and because the rider did specify a sub-location. The driver's anti-farming position (claim 5) is correct as far as it goes — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 92, so neither limb of the POL-NS-07 check trips, and those are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test — but it changes nothing, because no compensation route is reached. The rider's POL-NS-04 point is not needed and does not carry her case: the driver replied 'ok' at 12:31:26, within 120 seconds of the rider's 12:30:56 message, so the clause does not exonerate her on driver non-response. Her presence is in fact affirmatively established (54 qualifying rider fixes, never more than 19.9 m from the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius), which contradicts the RIDER_NO_SHOW label, but the refund follows from the driver's own trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 regardless. Her point that the 12:30:36 event is a driver-pressed marker is accepted: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival. I do not record a false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii): that referral requires the GPS to place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp or moving at 15 km/h or more, and a closest approach of 258.2 m establishes neither, so no clause-mandated referral fires here. Confidence and effect. The facts the ruling rests on are carried by EV-GPS-02712, EV-TRIP-02712 and EV-CHAT-02712, all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the $4.50 fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so no POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) fires and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger holds; confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02712-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact relied on here. The monetary effect ($4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Two rider claims that relied on the weight-0.0 advisory without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment were discarded by the referee and are recorded in the audit below.
To both parties. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02712 (EV-FARE-02712: total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is payable. The fee cannot stand under POL-NS-01. Limb (a) is met (the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:30:36) and limb (d) is met on its face (the driver terminated at 12:34:59 under RIDER_NO_SHOW), but limb (b) is decided by the GPS geofence, not by the tap: on EV-GPS-02712 the driver's closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), well outside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), and the trace contains 0 qualifying in-radius fixes (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 s). Limb (b) fails, and limb (c) fails with it: the in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period carried on the record (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 180 s shortfall under POL-NS-06. POL-NS-02 confirms the full refund. Because the closest fixes lie outside the 120 m radius but within POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling (258.2 m < 400 m), the trip is a wrong-approach case and POL-NS-03 also refunds the fee in full. Fault for driver compensation runs against the driver: the rider's locating message at 12:30:56 on EV-CHAT-02712 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') named her entrance, and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59 - POL-NS-03 limb (i); the pin-ambiguity goodwill in limb (ii) is unavailable because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. POL-NS-07 therefore pays nothing. On the driver's points: I accept that POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out, that 263 s elapsed from the 12:30:36 tap to the 12:34:59 cancellation, and that POL-NS-07's anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the 4 required, and 1/92 = 1.09 percent, below the 8 percent limb) - those being the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test. None of that saves the fee, because the dwell that matters is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and there is none. The 12:30:36 tap is a driver-pressed marker (platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON); it records only that the driver set it, POL-NS-12 covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals, and POL-NS-05 does not catch a driver standing within 300 m of the pin (258.2 m here), which is why the case is decided under POL-NS-03. On the rider's POL-NS-04 point: the rider's device was indeed present (54 fixes, never more than 19.9 m from the pin, inside the 150 m rider-presence radius), but POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because the driver replied 'ok' 30 s after her message, inside the 120 s window of limb (b). The refund does not depend on POL-NS-04; it rests on POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06. Impairment, weight and confidence: the deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-02712 and EV-TRIP-02712, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d), and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. EV-ADVIS-02712-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries nothing; the two claims that cited it without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code were discarded by the referee, and it is not needed here, the shortfall standing on the driver's own track. The refund of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04.
Both parties are told the same thing: the SGD 4.50 no-show fee charged on TRP-02712 does not stand and is refunded in full to the rider, with no driver compensation. Why the fee fails. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. Limbs (a) and (d) are made out on EV-TRIP-02712: it carries the driver's arrival event at 12:30:36 and a driver termination at 12:34:59 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Limbs (b) and (c) fail. Limb (c) measures the wait from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap, and on EV-GPS-02712 (weight 1.0) there are 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 91 driver fixes; the nearest approach anywhere on the trace is 258.2 m, against the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius that applies because trip_record.pickup_zone_class is LARGE_VENUE. The effective dwell is therefore 0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force on this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) — a shortfall of 180 s. POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix before the 12:34:59 cancellation) and POL-NS-06 (dwell shorter than the free waiting period) each refund the cancellation-fee line in full. EV-FARE-02712 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The driver's timing argument is rejected. He says 263 s ran from the 12:30:36 arrival event to the 12:34:59 cancellation, and 261 s from the 12:30:38 wait timer, both longer than 180 s. That is the time he allowed, not the dwell the clause requires: POL-NS-01(c) fixes the dwell to the in-geofence GPS fixes, and there are none. Under POL-NS-06 the fee comes back on that shortfall whether or not the rider was present or replied, so how long the driver was willing to wait does not decide anything. The wrong-approach route reaches the same result. The driver's 258.2 m nearest fix is outside the 120 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so the fee is refunded in full either way — under POL-NS-03 if he held position outside the radius for the required dwell, and under POL-NS-02 if he did not. On fault, POL-NS-03 puts the loss on the driver: the rider stated her location in EV-CHAT-02712 at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A') and the driver did not move to it before cancelling. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of 50% of the fee ($2.25) is unavailable because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. Driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; it is not satisfied, so nothing is payable to the driver. The anti-farming check does not trip and bars nothing: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by 92 completed trips is 1.09% (below 8%). Those two fields, and completed_trips_30d, are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test, and no other profile field has been used against either party. Rider's coordination point. POL-NS-04 is not needed and is not relied on for the refund: the rider's device sat within 19.9 m of the pin across 54 qualifying fixes (12:28:14–12:36:13), well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, but the refund flows from the driver's position, not hers. The driver's 'ok' at 12:31:26, 30 s after her 12:30:56 message, also means POL-NS-04(b) was not failed, so that clause neither exonerates nor condemns. Arrival marker. The 12:30:36 arrival is a driver-pressed BUTTON (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON), not a GPS_AUTO platform measurement, so POL-NS-12 cannot convert it into a platform-confirmed arrival; it stays subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. Impairment, escalation and referrals. The only impaired artifact is EV-ADVIS-02712-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY, MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). It carries no fact and the ruling does not rely on it; its absence is why POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to sum separate in-geofence intervals, and the zero dwell stands without it. No POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment touches the deciding evidence: no clock skew (the 12:30:36 arrival event coincides with a 10 s fix), no trace gap (100% coverage, max gap 0.0 s), the chat sequence and count reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count, and the 4.50 fare line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so no POL-NS-07, POL-NS-08 or POL-NS-09 escalation applies, and no clause produces a referral. Money. The whole contested amount, $4.50, is refunded, and the $4.50 monetary effect is at or below the $8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so this provisional ruling executes automatically, subject to the appeal route in POL-GEN-04.
